hook.line: Claude Code can now reverse engineer software you don't even have the code for.
hook.visual: Face cut out at bottom left over a screenshot of an X post with a GitHub README; red banner 'CLAUDE CAN REVERSE ENGINEER APPS' on top; one-word captions mid-frame.

beats.what: Bold claim spoken over the X-post screenshot, red title banner and word-by-word captions on from frame one
Face cutout jumps from bottom left to a small box at the right of the README as the explanation starts
Face moves again to the left edge on 'here's what makes this different'
Face drops to the bottom of the frame while he names the limit: it won't clone every app
Face moves to the upper left for the close: save this, try it, comment

why_it_works: The claim is in the first sentence and in a red banner, so the topic is clear before the viewer can scroll
The background is a real post with 1.9M views, which borrows authority without a word of setup
Moving the face cutout every 8-15 s gives a pattern change in a video with zero cuts
Ending on a question plus 'save this' turns a news item into a comment and save prompt
weaknesses: No cuts and one static screenshot for 44 s; the face moves are the only motion
The README text is unreadable at phone size, so the screen adds proof but no detail
Program loudness of -23.2 LUFS is quiet for TikTok
for_robert: Move the presenter, not the camera: relocate Robert's cutout (or Fred) to a new corner at each new point so a single-take reel still changes picture every few seconds.
